artists.biography:
Wisdom of Crowds is the exciting new project featuring Bruce Soord from The Pineapple Thief with Jonas Renkse from Katatonia.
Originally written with Renkse’s voice in mind, Soord sought out the acclaimed Katatonia vocalist to complete the compositions and release the music to the masses. Despite the rigorous schedules of The Pineapple Thief and Katatonia, the two musicians were eventually able to connect.
Both artists are currently enjoying unparalleled success with their main bands.

perplexity.description:
Ghosts In The Park is Bruce Soord’s fourth solo studio album, released on Kscope in 2026, and it is widely framed as his most personal and reflective work to date. Written in the aftermath of his father’s death, the album deals with loss, memory, grief, and the way ordinary moments can become charged with meaning when viewed in hindsight.

Musically, the record sits in a rock context but leans toward the more atmospheric, acoustic, and introspective side of Soord’s writing, with careful arrangements that emphasize songcraft and emotional detail over force. Reviews describe it as a stark yet elegant companion to his earlier solo work, balancing restraint with strong melodic and textural depth.
